answer: In a sonnet contest on marble and ember, an in-person registrar checks photo IDs and a registry of ID numbers, issuing one contest-bound signed credential per new ID and refusing mismatches or repeats. The server verifies the signature and contest binding, accepts one vote per credential, and rejects invalid or reused ones. Each extra credential needs another accepted ID and visit; borrowed IDs remain a risk, and people without accepted IDs are excluded.
